sloka: इन्द्रियैः अप्रह्Rष्टैअः तम् शोक सम्ताप कर्शितम् ।निह्श्वसन्तम् महा राजम् व्यथित आकुल चेतसम् ॥२-१८-५॥
transliteration: indriyaiḥ aprahRṣṭaiaḥ tam śoka samtāpa karśitam ।nihśvasantam mahā rājam vyathita ākula cetasam ॥2-18-5॥

translations.english: Maharaja (Dasaratha) with his senses dulled had become emaciated due to sorrow and suffering. With an agitated and troubled mind, he was breathing heavily. Although unshakable, he looked agitated like an ocean with successive rows of waves, like the Sun in eclipse, like an ascetic who has uttered falsehood.
translations.hindi: जो सब प्राणियों के एक मात्र सहारे हैं, उन्हीं श्रीरामचन्द्र को वनवास दे महाराज एक अनाड़ी की तरह प्रजा का नाश करने पर उतारू हैं
